description: The bar chart illustrates the performance of three different schema linking modules—DIN-SQL (zero-shot), TA-SQL (zero-shot), and DIN-SQL (few-shot)—across three metrics: Recall, Precision, and F1 Score. The horizontal axis represents the categories, which are the three metrics, while the vertical axis represents the value, ranging from 40 to 100. The bars are color-coded, with DIN-SQL (zero-shot) in light blue, TA-SQL (zero-shot) in dark blue, and DIN-SQL (few-shot) in green. The Recall scores are 63.58 for DIN-SQL (zero-shot), 71.90 for TA-SQL (zero-shot), and 72.29 for DIN-SQL (few-shot). The Precision scores are 88.89 for DIN-SQL (zero-shot), 91.24 for TA-SQL (zero-shot), and 92.31 for DIN-SQL (few-shot). The F1 Scores are 75.34 for DIN-SQL (zero-shot), 80.40 for TA-SQL (zero-shot), and 81.08 for DIN-SQL (few-shot). The chart does not indicate any specific sorting or emphasis on the bars.
